southeast.title: RCMP investigating trio of suspicious wildfires in Grand Forks, B.C.
southeast.description: Firefighters in Grand Forks, B.C., were called to three wildfires this weekend they say are suspicious.

all.title: Details of fatal firefighter helicopter crash during Colorado’s Gold Mountain Fire revealed
all.description: The first investigation report into a helicopter crash that left a pilot dead during Colorado’s Gold Mountain Fire on July 12 was released by the National Transportation Safety Board on Wednesday. all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
all.description: A drug marketed to wildland firefighters exposed to smoke or PFAS shows no evidence of being effective, leading the International Association of Firefighters and the Food and Drug Administration to warn against its use. all.title: Over 90,000 evacuate as uncontained Hawk Fire burns outside Reno, Nevada
all.description: The Hawk Fire burning northwest of Reno, Nevada, triggered the evacuations of over 90,000 people on Sunday, according to fire crews working the incident. all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. all.title: Largest wildfire in Belgium’s history triggers explosions, burns over half of nation’s oldest nature preserve
all.description: A wildfire has burned over half of a historic nature preserve in Belgium near the country’s border with Germany, triggering explosions and evacuations in multiple nearby villages.
